description: Channel-aware STT cleanup eval set. Each case is one raw speech transcript for a target app, the channel it should map to, an illustrative expected output, and machine-checkable assertions. `assert.resolvesTo` and `assert.promptIncludes` are checked statically (no LLM); `assert.output` is checked live against POST /cleanup when PYAI_PROXY_URL is set. See run.mjs and README.md.

cases.useCase: Formal email — follow-up after a meeting
cases.rawStt: hey um so it was really nice to meet you the other day uh i was wondering when can we meet next like maybe sometime next week
cases.expected:
Hi,

It was really nice to meet you the other day. When could we meet next — perhaps sometime next week?

Thanks,

cases.useCase: Formal email via the desktop "email" alias (must map to gmail style)
cases.rawStt: can you please send me the q3 report by friday i need it for the board deck thanks
cases.expected:
Hi,

Could you please send me the Q3 report by Friday? I need it for the board deck.

Thanks,

cases.useCase: Casual chat — quick teammate update, no greeting/sign-off
cases.rawStt: um yeah i just pushed the fix for the login bug it should be good now can you take a look when you get a sec
cases.expected: Just pushed the fix for the login bug — should be good now. Can you take a look when you get a sec?

cases.useCase: Casual chat via the "teams" alias (must map to slack style)
cases.rawStt: hey are we still on for the standup at ten this morning
cases.expected: Are we still on for the standup at 10 this morning?

cases.useCase: Notes — a run-on to-do list should become bullets
cases.rawStt: okay so i need to do a few things i need to email sarah and then i have to update the deck and also book the flights for the offsite
cases.expected:
- Email Sarah
- Update the deck
- Book the flights for the offsite

cases.useCase: Notes via the "notion" alias — terse takeaway
cases.rawStt: meeting takeaway so basically the launch is getting pushed to march because of the api dependency that isn't ready yet
cases.expected: Launch pushed to March — API dependency not ready.

cases.useCase: Docs — clean prose, no email framing
cases.rawStt: um so basically the goal of this project is to reduce latency and uh we want to do that by caching and also by moving to a cdn
cases.expected: The goal of this project is to reduce latency, achieved through caching and by moving to a CDN.

cases.useCase: Code via the "vscode" alias — terse technical comment
cases.rawStt: um this function retries the request three times with exponential backoff before giving up
cases.expected: Retries the request three times with exponential backoff before giving up.

cases.useCase: Default — plain cleanup, no target-app rewrite
cases.rawStt: um so i think we should uh probably go with the second option since it's cheaper
cases.expected: I think we should probably go with the second option since it's cheaper.
